certificates.name: Apple Sign-In Client Secret (Entra IDP) - Dev
certificates.notes: Apple client secrets expire every 6 months. Renew in the DEV Entra tenant (TrashMobEcoDev) portal: External Identities > All identity providers > Apple > re-select the .p8 key file (d:/tools/Apple/TrashMobEntraDev_AuthKey_KSP56LUPCG.p8) > Save. The file field always shows empty when reopened (browser security), and Service ID/Team ID/Key ID fields staying populated does NOT mean the secret was rotated -- you must actively re-select the file and Save to mint a fresh JWT. Rotated 2026-09-12.

certificates.name: Apple Sign-In Client Secret (Entra IDP) - Prod

Renew in the PROD Entra tenant (TrashMobEcoPr) portal: External Identities > All identity providers > Apple > re-select the .p8 key file (d:/tools/Apple/TrashMobEntraProd_AuthKey_535PNV2RYU.p8) > Save. Same caveats as the dev entry apply. Rotated 2026-09-12.
